description: Change the recipient, body, tier or colour of a draft that has not been sent, and re-price it. Returns a new page count and a new quote, so the previous total is void — state the new total to the user before sending. The 6-printed-page maximum applies to the new body as well: a replacement that renders to 7 or more pages is refused and the draft is left as it was. This creates nothing and mails nothing.

body_markdown.description: Replaces the whole letter text. It must render to 6 printed pages or fewer — roughly 2,400 words of body text.

colour.description: Omit this. The current price card prints black & white only; true is refused.

tier.description: Which product to buy. Call get_pricing first and pass a tier it lists: standard is a plain First-Class letter. certified, certified_err, proof_of_mailing and registered are other products the current price card may not sell, and a tier it does not sell is refused rather than substituted — so do not describe one to the user until get_pricing has listed it.

to.description: A complete US postal address. US domestic addresses only.

line1.description: Street number and street name, or PO box.

name.description: The person or company the letter is addressed to.

postal_code.description: Five-digit ZIP or ZIP+4, such as 10001 or 10001-2345.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code, such as NY.

name: update_draft

draft_id.description: Pass this to preview_draft, update_draft and send_letter.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 instant the draft is deleted. Nothing is charged if it expires.

included_pages.description: Printed pages the headline price covers. This draft is priced at that total up to this many pages.

note.description: The next call to make. Read it before answering the user.

page_count.description: Printed pages, as counted by the renderer. Never more than 6 — a longer body is refused.

quote.description: A priced letter. State total.display to the user before sending, and pass total.amount_cents as confirm_total_cents.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 instant after which this total is re-computed from the live price card. Call preview_draft for a fresh quote before sending if it has passed.

quote_id.description: Identifier for this quote, for support and receipts.

subtotal.description: What the letter costs, before sales tax.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

collected.description: New York sales tax on this letter. We mail from New York, so a few cents apply wherever the letter goes, and more when it is going to New York.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

total.description: Subtotal plus sales tax. This is the number send_letter requires in confirm_total_cents.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

version.description: The published price card this total came from.

sheet_count.description: Sheets of paper this letter is printed on: one page per sheet, one side each, up to 3 pages; a letter of 4 to 6 pages is printed on both sides, so it is never more than 3 sheets.

tier.description: The product this draft is priced as, as passed to create_draft or update_draft.

tier_title.description: What the price card in force calls that product, such as Standard. Use this name when you tell the user what they are buying.

title: Update a Letter Draft
